item.title: Ask HN: If the models are so good, why doesn't OpenAI just start 100 companies?
item.description: Title is a bit of an exaggeration but the question is more: if the frontier models are so good, why even sell them as your primary money maker? Couldn't OpenAI or Anthropic make a lot more money by just starting companies themselves that leverage the models and building their own products? Is selling tokens really the best strategy? Especially with commodification and prices declining wouldn't that indicate there is more money to be made on the application-side of the models rather than the utility side Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50200997 Points: 258 # Comments: 267 Fuente: Hacker News - Portada.

item.title: The FCC is beginning to block gadgets with ‘foreign surveillance chips’
item.description: On October 13th, Brendan Carr's FCC gave itself a new power - it can block gadgets for containing any computer chip made by any company on its list of potential threats to national security. Today, it's exercising that power for the first time, blocking two gadgets because they contain "foreign surveillance chips," the FCC claims. […] Fuente: The Verge.
